capabilities: Display a hierarchical view of inlinks and outlinks for the current note
Traverse link connections a configurable number of levels deep
Show links from Canvas files that embed the current note
Toggle outlinks of inlinks to see where linking notes point
Open linked notes from the view via click or Cmd/Ctrl+Click
extras: Docs cover only internal (resolved) links; frontmatter links are also picked up. README ends with a self-deprecating note that it may over-explain.
intentEvidence: navigate via "Backlinks" core plugin 1 page a time
motivation: The author replaced slow custom DataviewJS queries (120-170ms per query) with a faster view that loads in 2-15ms, and wanted to find embedded notes and MOCs without remembering titles.
problem: Obsidian's Backlinks and Outgoing links core plugins show links one page at a time and omit Canvas links, making deep contextual navigation slow.

relations.evidence: In the past I used custom DatviewJS queries, to navigate notes.

summary: Link hierarchy viewer that navigates a note's inlinks and outlinks N levels deep, including links found in Canvas files.
